title: panicum miliaceum subsp. ruderale
intro: Panicum miliaceum subsp. ruderale, commonly known as wild proso millet, is a subspecies of millet that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to help lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of wild proso millet include its anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
